name: Homelable
description: Draw and monitor your whole homelab as a live, interactive diagram

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database (all canvases, devices and settings), uploaded floor plans, the secret key and the admin password file.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Homelable web app and API, published on host as 6151

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address you open Homelable at, like http://192.168.1.20:6151. Change localhost to your server IP. Use your own domain if you put Homelable behind HTTPS.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The password for the admin login. Leave it empty and one is made for you on first start; it is shown in the app logs. Type your own to change it at any time.
